The combination of declining revenue, increasing debt, decreased equity and large losses leads to a strongly negative sentiment. While an increase in cash and short term investments seems positive, it does not offset the overall negative trends. The company needs to address its declining sales, manage its debt, and improve profitability urgently to avoid further deterioration in performance and investor confidence.
